v003.title: Rates are rising. Should you wait?
v003.cap:
Rates are rising again, and some buyers are pausing. ⏳

But prices didn't pause. Last quarter they still rose 1.4%. On a $2M home that's $28,000 more. A 0.25% rate rise on a $1.5M loan adds about $200 a month. That $28K is over 11 years of the extra interest.

On a floating or fixed loan right now? Comment FLOAT or FIXED 👇

v004.title: Your CPF wants its money back
v004.cap:
You sell your HDB for $800,000. But far less cash lands in your bank. 🏦

Every CPF dollar you used goes back to your CPF, plus 2.5% a year compounded. Used $300K 15 years ago? That's about $435K back to CPF, a $135K difference in your cash proceeds.

Cash or CPF to service your mortgage? Comment CASH or CPF 👇

v005.title: Property moves like dominoes
v005.cap:
Singapore property moves like dominoes: HDB, then EC, then private condo. 🁢

The 15 month wait is gone and the EC income ceiling is now $18,000. Both bring more buyers in.

Which domino are you watching? Comment HDB, EC or CONDO 👇

v006.title: Your flat has a hidden clock
v006.cap:
You own an older HDB and want to sell. But your buyer can't borrow enough. ⏰

Buyers can only use CPF fully if the lease covers them to age 95. If not, CPF use is cut and loans can shrink too.

How many years are left on your lease? Tell us below 👇

v007.cap:
A new EC and a new condo, almost the same price. Which do you pick? 🤔

Historically the EC to condo gap was over 60%, and EC buyers made more. Today it is around 5%.

v010.title: Why the bank said no
v010.cap:
You earn $10,000 a month. The bank just said no. 🏦

It's not your salary. It's your other loans. TDSR caps all repayments at 55% of income, and HDB or EC loans also face a 30% MSR.

Know someone buying a car and a house? Send this to them 📲

v011.title: Why new launches won't get cheaper
v011.cap:
You are a developer. You just paid $1,400 psf for land. You can't sell cheap. 🏗️

Rule of thumb: launch price is about 2.2 times land price. Sky at Holland and Vela Bay both followed it.
